item.title: Welcome to Paradise - Episode Plan for 26 October 2026
item.description: This episode covers major developments in France's education reforms amid student protests, Brazil's presidential election surprise and its economic repercussions, the unfolding Middle East tensions with a focus on Israel and Iran, the AI industry's financial surge and risks spotlighted by Anthropic's IPO filing, and the US political and legal battles surrounding press freedom under the Trump administration.
